name: Webeyez
description:
Webeyez helps Claude analyze your website performance, customer journeys, conversion funnels, technical issues, and revenue opportunities using natural language.

Instead of digging through dashboards, simply ask Claude questions about your store and receive AI-powered insights based on your Webeyez data.

You can use Webeyez to:

• Explain sudden conversion drops
• Identify checkout failures and abandoned journeys
• Find the highest revenue-impact issues
• Analyze funnels and customer journeys
• Review session recordings and user behavior
• Investigate JavaScript errors and failed API calls
• Detect rage clicks, dead clicks, and customer frustration
• Monitor Core Web Vitals and website performance
• Compare segments by device, browser, country, campaign, or traffic source
• Summarize today’s biggest opportunities
• Generate executive summaries from analytics data
• Prioritize fixes based on business impact

Ask Claude things like:

* “Why did conversions drop today?”
* “What’s costing us the most revenue?”
* “Show me checkout issues from the last 24 hours.”
* “Summarize today’s biggest customer experience problems.”
* “Which marketing campaigns have the highest friction?”
* “Which JavaScript errors affect the most customers?”
* “What should my engineering team fix first?”
* “What changed after yesterday’s deployment?”
* “Which customer segments struggle most during checkout?”
* “Create an executive summary of this week’s website performance.”

Webeyez combines digital experience analytics, customer journey analytics, session replay, heatmaps, website monitoring, AI insights, and revenue impact analysis in one platform—helping eCommerce, product, marketing, UX, and engineering teams resolve issues faster and improve conversions.

Supported platforms include Shopify, Shopify Plus, Magento, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, commercetools, VTEX, and custom eCommerce platforms.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Webeyez to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Webeyez to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.app.webeyez.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Webeyez MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Webeyez provides these MCP tools: check_webeyez_status, get_organization_domains, get_organizations_list, get_session_recording_links, logout_webeyez, start_webeyez_query, and submit_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Webeyez?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Webeyez in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Webeyez requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Webeyez is developed by Webeyez. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
